Description: Verify the existence and attributes of the username field

Expected Result: Visible, enabled, and of type 'text' or 'input'

Description: Verify the existence and attributes of the password field
Test Steps: 1. Load login page\n2. Inspect Password element
Expected Result: Visible, enabled, and of type 'password'

Description: Verify the existence and attributes of the submit button
Test Steps: 1. Load login page\n2. Inspect Login button
Expected Result: Visible, enabled, and of type 'submit'

Description: Verify the existence and text of the forgot password link
Test Steps: 1. Load login page\n2. Inspect Forgot Password link
Expected Result: Visible, with text 'Forgot your password?'

Description: Verify the login header banner text
Test Steps: 1. Load login page\n2. Locate main heading
Expected Result: Heading contains text 'Login'

Description: Verify authentication works with correct credentials
Test Steps: 1. Enter valid username (Admin)\n2. Enter valid password (admin123)\n3. Click Login
Expected Result: Redirects successfully to Dashboard (URL contains '/dashboard')

Description: Verify Forgot Password page navigation
Test Steps: 1. Click 'Forgot your password?' link
Expected Result: Redirects successfully to Reset Password page (URL contains '/requestPasswordResetCode')

Description: Verify system behavior for invalid username
Test Steps: 1. Enter invalid username\n2. Enter valid password\n3. Click Login
Expected Result: Login fails; error message 'Invalid credentials' is displayed; remains on login page

Description: Verify system behavior for invalid password
Test Steps: 1. Enter valid username\n2. Enter invalid password\n3. Click Login
Expected Result: Login fails; error message 'Invalid credentials' is displayed; remains on login page

Description: Verify system behavior for both invalid credentials
Test Steps: 1. Enter invalid username\n2. Enter invalid password\n3. Click Login
Expected Result: Login fails; error message 'Invalid credentials' is displayed; remains on login page

Description: Verify validation when username is missing
Test Steps: 1. Leave username empty\n2. Enter valid password\n3. Click Login
Expected Result: Validation message 'Required' is displayed under the username input; remains on login page

Description: Verify validation when password is missing
Test Steps: 1. Enter valid username\n2. Leave password empty\n3. Click Login
Expected Result: Validation message 'Required' is displayed under the password input; remains on login page

Description: Verify validation when both fields are missing
Test Steps: 1. Leave both username and password empty\n2. Click Login
Expected Result: Validation message 'Required' is displayed under both inputs; remains on login page

Description: Verify defense against basic SQL Injection in username field
Test Steps: 1. Enter SQL injection payload in username\n2. Enter valid password\n3. Click Login
Expected Result: Login fails; error message 'Invalid credentials' is displayed; stays on login page

Description: Verify defense against XSS script tag injection in username field
Test Steps: 1. Enter script tags in username\n2. Enter valid password\n3. Click Login
Expected Result: Login fails; error message 'Invalid credentials' is displayed; script does not execute

Description: Verify input validation for special characters
Test Steps: 1. Enter special characters in username\n2. Enter valid password\n3. Click Login
Expected Result: Login fails; error message 'Invalid credentials' is displayed; stays on login page

Description: Verify buffer/input length robustness on username field
Test Steps: 1. Enter 500+ characters in username\n2. Enter valid password\n3. Click Login
Expected Result: Login fails; error message 'Invalid credentials' is displayed; system does not crash
